targets.label: Cloudflare quick tunnel
caveats: The link is public the moment it opens -- anyone who has it can reach the app, so the API key is the only thing between a stranger and your data.
The address changes every time you run it. For a stable one you need a Cloudflare account and a named tunnel.
It ends when you stop it or the machine sleeps.

targets.label: ngrok
caveats: Needs a free account and an auth token before the first run.
Inspect every request that arrives at http://127.0.0.1:4040 -- useful when a webhook is not behaving.
The free plan shows an interstitial page to first-time visitors.

targets.label: Own domain via the shared ingress
caveats: You need a domain whose DNS points at this machine, and ports 80 and 443 reachable from outside.
Caddy obtains a real certificate automatically once a real hostname replaces ':443'. Until then it issues its own, which browsers will warn about.
Uptime and backups are yours. Nothing restarts this app if the machine reboots unless you installed the service (_ops/Install-Service.ps1).

targets.label: Render + Neon Postgres
caveats: The app must have been generated with db.engine: Postgres. The engine is baked in at generation time and no environment variable changes it.
The container sleeps after 15 minutes idle. Waking it costs a cold start, and this app runs schema lifecycle on every boot -- budget noticeably longer than a plain Spring app.
There is no persistent disk. Set NPDEV_SUPERUSER_BOOTSTRAPKEYHASH so the ControlPanel key does not depend on a file surviving.
Set database.databaseName explicitly in db.definition.json, or every regeneration expects a brand-new database and startup refuses.
targets.incompatibleReason: Needs a Postgres app -- this one uses H2Server

targets.label: Koyeb + TiDB MySQL
caveats: The app must have been generated with db.engine: MySQL.
More database storage than Render + Neon, less CPU (0.1 vCPU) -- boot is slower, steady-state is fine.
utf8mb4 is not optional on MySQL. The emitted .env already carries this; do not override the charset.
No persistent disk -- same super-user key caveat as Render.
targets.incompatibleReason: Needs a MySQL app -- this one uses H2Server

targets.label: Render, embedded H2
caveats: Everything written to this app is erased when the container restarts or wakes from sleep. Not some of it -- all of it.
The ControlPanel super-user key is erased with it, so set NPDEV_SUPERUSER_BOOTSTRAPKEYHASH or you will be locked out.
Fine for showing someone the shape of an app. Never for anything a person will type real work into.

targets.label: VPS or Oracle Cloud ARM
caveats: The docker-compose.yml NPDev already emits IS this deployment -- app, database, healthchecks, log caps, optional backup and observability profiles.
No sleep and no cold starts, so the per-boot schema lifecycle stops mattering.
You administer the machine: updates, certificates and backups are yours. The emitted backup profile handles the database; nothing handles the host.
